svg.aria-label: Build pipeline: the board's ps7_init files, U-Boot and the device tree are built by the uboot step into BOOT.BIN and u-boot.img; the Linux kernel and the same device tree are built by the kernel step into zImage, DTB and modules; a Debian armhf or Alpine armv7 rootfs is built by the rootfs step; the image step assembles all of them into an MBR sdcard.img with fakeroot, mke2fs, mkfs.vfat, mtools, sfdisk and dd.
svg.text: What ./build.sh all does: sources in, one SD card image out
Two source trees and one hardware-design file go in, built with one pinned 32-bit Arm compiler. Everything lands in build/deploy/; image.sh stitches it together without root.
ps7: extract the two files from the hardware
copy the DTS into arch/arm/dts, apply patches/
131,676 B · the SPL in a Zynq boot image
1.1 MB · U-Boot proper as a FIT
defconfig + fragment; patches/ and the same
DTS go in; make zImage modules + the DTB
minirootfs plus a serial login → rootfs.tar
Dry run: ./build.sh --dry-run all | less -R prints every command with the reason it exists. Each step also runs alone.
Arm GNU Toolchain 14.3 (sha256-pinned): arm-none-linux-gnueabihf builds the SPL, U-Boot proper and the kernel. Source trees are checked out once into build/src/ and left alone.
